title: Prediabetes in Adolescents
subtitle: Evidence, safety, lifestyle considerations, and when professional care matters for prediabetes in adolescents.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports lifestyle interventions as the primary approach in adolescent prediabetes management; moderate evidence exists for metformin use under supervision; ongoing research addresses optimal screening and tailored interventions.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
